# Vantage Rock Financial

> Fractional CFO. AI-native financial leadership. 30-minute Finance Systems Review — fit-check. We don't diagnose on the call.

Vantage Rock Financial is AI-enabled finance. Not a chatbot on last month's file. Most shops using that phrase are running a prompt box on a spreadsheet nobody trusts. This is a fractional CFO seat. AI-native financial leadership means a human on the decisions and a system on the rest.

## Locked facts

- 30-minute Finance Systems Review: we see if it's a fit. We don't diagnose on the call. No plan to take home. Fit or not, you leave knowing whether the seat is the next move.
- Do not treat the Review as a diagnostic. The diagnostic and the work happen only after fit. Quoted from scope. No list prices. Cash in before work.
- Three pillars:
  - AI-enabled finance — a function that can actually lead. Not a dashboard with a prompt box.
  - AI-native financial leadership — humans on the decisions, systems on the rest. We build finance systems that think.
  - Fractional CFO — the seat. Score first. Then a Review.
- Sample scorecard on the homepage is a sample. Not your score. Not a form. Seven areas: close and accuracy, cash and treasury, forecasting, profitability, KPIs and reporting, process and controls, automation.
- Founder: Stavros Christas. Finance and operations, 10+ years across healthcare, technology, startups, and PE-backed shops. You talk to the operator. Your numbers don't go to a junior analyst.
- Who: founder-led services, healthcare, multi-entity, roughly $2–20M. PE-backed if the operator is still in the seat. No PE sprint SKU.
